DIAGNOSIS READY: Primary Biliary Cholangitis (PBC).

The combination of significantly elevated Alkaline Phosphatase, elevated bilirubin, a "thin-walled" gallbladder on ultrasound (suggesting chronic cholestasis), and your age and gender profile is highly characteristic of PBC.
